objective: PR6 repair (worktree /home/user/wt/pr6): close the guard's bypasses found in review and harden the CI step.
constraints: Keep the bunx pin (no new devDependency).
AGENTS.md stays as is unless the allowlist changes.
acceptance_criteria: Bare builtin specifiers (fs, fs/promises, path, os, child_process and any other Node builtin, detected with isBuiltin from node:module or an equivalent) are treated as node: imports and checked against the allowlist, so `import { readFileSync } from "fs"` fails.
An import whose braces span lines and contain comments is parsed (comments stripped before matching), with a sanity assertion that the scan parsed imports from the tree.
The scan also covers plugin/ and .mts/.cts files, skipping node_modules and the generated bundle.
The CI validate step runs right after dependency install (before format), with DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1 in its env.
Each new rule is shown red on a temporary violation and green on the tree; format, lint, typecheck and test pass.
